assessment.valuationDefinition: Two-sided CPMM liquidity / spot fully diluted valuation in the quote asset.

flags.detail: Raydium CPMM current LP redemption rules verified; program upgrade authority and LP-lock program custody are separate evidence.

limitations: Raydium CPMM calculations are not applied to AMM v4, CLMM, stable pools or unrelated architectures.
Token-2022 transfer fees and other unsupported transfer controls require separate quote handling.
LP locks and all-pool inventory are unverified; withdrawal exposure is a conservative upper bound.

protocolEvidence.limitation: Protocol-state quote calculation does not establish transaction simulation, fill guarantee, program upgrade authority or LP custody.

flags.detail: Protocol global operation controls remain separate from LP redemption exposure; a retained protocol administrator can change operation flags. Program upgrade authority is not certified by this calculation.

limitations: Protocol quote at the observed slot, not a guaranteed transaction fill.
Pool concentration covers returned pools only; other architectures require their own decoder.

LP claim is a mathematical upper bound, not proof that all holders can currently redeem or that LP custody is permanently locked. Current withdrawal-disable state and protocol admin are separate from lock and program-upgrade assessment.
Historical fee-recipient authorization is a separate unresolved observation.
assessment.valuationDefinition: Two-sided pool liquidity divided by spot fully diluted valuation, both denominated in SOL; not circulating market capitalization.

protocolEvidence.limitation: Protocol-state quote calculation does not establish transaction simulation, fill guarantee, program upgrade authority or LP custody.
